attempts.summary: Configured node1, node2, node3 as a three-member MariaDB Galera cluster (MariaDB 10.4.19 + galera-4 from the official MariaDB xenial repo, after discovering Ubuntu's stock mariadb-server-10.0 lacked WSREP support). Verified multi-master write replication in all directions, verified the cluster stays available and writable with one member down (quorum preserved at size 2), verified the downed member auto-resynced and caught up on all rows written while offline, and completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes with boot-id proof of actual reboot plus full cluster health/data recovery after each.
